chapter_title_en: The Wind Rises Beyond the Seas – The Challenge (Part 1)
chapter_keywords: a record of a mortal’s journey to immortality
chapter_seo_title: A Record of a Mortal’s Journey to Immortality Ch. 374: The Challenge Begins
chapter_meta_description: Han Li arrives at Eaststone City on Starfall Island during its massive market day. He enters a structured Qi Condensation tournament, faces a confident opponent two layers above him, and lets out a quiet, knowing laugh.
og_title: The Challenge Tournament Begins on Starfall Island
og_description: Han Li enters a Qi Condensation tournament on Starfall Island—structured fights, no killing, and a confident opponent who’s about to get a surprise.
twitter_description: Han Li enters a Qi Condensation elimination match on Starfall Island. His opponent, two layers above, expects an easy win. That laugh says otherwise.

lore_anchors.definition: A palm-sized jade disc embedded in a cylinder that allows mortals to identify cultivators by their spiritual power fluctuations, even though the mortals themselves have no magical ability.
The central city of Starfall Island, an eastern territory of the Tianluo Nation; hosts a massive market day every three months where goods from over a dozen regional towns are traded.
The first major stage of cultivation, where a practitioner gathers and condenses qi within their body; Han Li is at the fifth layer, his opponent at the seventh layer in this chapter.
A structured elimination bout system where low-level cultivators compete for the right to replace existing merchant representatives; single-elimination, no killing, winner takes the opponent’s lot.
The cultivation stage above Qi Condensation; the supervising elder in this chapter is at the Foundation Establishment stage, the only one in the room.
